title: Balanced FKN projection
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$, an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and a choice of whether to negate, define a Boolean function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ by evaluating the signed dictator at $i$ on the vector obtained by prepending $+1$ to the input.
caveat: The signed dictator is not defined in the supplied snippet, so its coordinate and negation conventions cannot be specified further.
